title: Reopening a paid work order keeps its representatives
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin at the test location.
  • Have three active staff members at the test location with their "Sales Representative" switch on: sales rep A, sales rep B and sales rep C.
  • Use a customer whose one Sales Representative is sales rep C.
  • Create a work order for this test for that customer with one approved labor line, one part, "Sales Representative - Labor" set to sales rep A and "Sales Representative - Parts" set to sales rep B, then invoice it and take payment in full.
  • Open the work order in a desktop browser at least 1024 pixels wide.
custom_steps:
1. Reopen the work order.
  2. Open the work order that reopening made and read its representative fields.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • A work order is made from the work order and can be edited.

Step 2:

  • It shows "Sales Representative - Labor" reading sales rep A and "Sales Representative - Parts" reading sales rep B.
  • Neither field shows the customer's sales rep C.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Splitting Sales Representatives", Confluence 919928833, version 11 (21 Oct 2026, Chris Ward), read 22 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-10890, story SV-11266 (Story 2, Give a work order a separate Labor and Parts representative), story SV-11268 (Story 4, Give a customer default representatives)
